# gws recipe: Copy a Sheet tab for the new month

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the copy-sheet-for-new-month recipe: duplicate a Google Sheets template tab for a new month of tracking — get the spreadsheet details, copy the template sheet with `sheets.copyTo`, then rename the new tab with `batchUpdate` — two real API calls, not one, a subtlety agents get wrong. Distinct from the lot 31 Sheets recipes (`backup-sheet-as-csv`, `compare-sheet-tabs`, `sync-contacts-to-sheet` — none cover the monthly template copy). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the `gws-sheets` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
